findings.summary: app/api/intake/route.ts's own bearer-token-mismatch 401 was wrongly scoped out of logAuthRefusal on the reasoning that it has no session actor -- it is the one endpoint facing anonymous internet traffic, making its refusals the highest-value ones in this batch to log.
findings.disposition: fixed before commit -- app/api/intake/route.ts now calls logAuthRefusal('POST /api/intake', 'bearer token mismatch', null) on that refusal; ART-20260906-041/042 re-versioned to ART-20260906-043/044 (v2) to bring it into scope

findings.summary: app/api/mail/file/route.ts's 'reconnect your inbox' 401 was not wired to logAuthRefusal, unlike the file's other three 401/403 sites.
findings.disposition: accepted, not fixed -- deliberate scope decision, confirmed correct by the reviewer: the caller is already an authenticated session with a benign onboarding-incomplete state (no connected mailbox yet), not a security-relevant refusal, so logging it would be noise rather than signal (recorded in ART-20260906-043's scope_out)
